description: This is a Java test class for the WizardPermissionsFragment in the AnySoftKeyboard project, containing unit tests for permission handling and UI behavior.

classes.name: WizardPermissionsFragmentTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the WizardPermissionsFragment UI and permission logic in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of WizardPermissionsFragment.

methods.name: testWhenNoPermissionsRequestNeeded
methods.description: Tests UI behavior when no permission request is needed, verifying visibility of permission groups.

methods.name: testKeyboardEnabledAndDefaultButNoPermission
methods.description: Tests UI when the keyboard is enabled and default but permissions are missing, including clicking links and toggling settings.

methods.name: testKeyboardEnabledAndDefaultButDictionaryDisabled
methods.description: Tests UI when the keyboard is enabled and default but the contacts dictionary is disabled.

methods.name: testKeyboardEnabledAndDefaultAndHasPermission
methods.description: Tests UI when the keyboard is enabled, default, and has the necessary contact permissions.

methods.name: testDoesNotShowNotificationGroupBeforeT
methods.description: Verifies notification permission group is hidden before Android T (SDK 33).

methods.name: testDoesNotShowNotificationGroupIfGranted
methods.description: Verifies notification permission group is hidden if permission is granted on Android T+.

methods.name: testShowNotificationGroupIfNotGranted
methods.description: Verifies notification permission group is visible if permission is not granted on Android T+.

methods.name: testHidesNotificationGroupIfNotGrantedButSkipped
methods.description: Tests hiding of notification permission group after user skips permission request.
